home.title: Manage your push notifications easily.
home.description: Centralize push campaigns in a modern workspace designed to feel lighter and easier to operate.

features.title: Everything you need to send your notifications.
features.description: Applications, devices, scheduled notifications and quiet periods: PushIT brings the whole delivery cycle into a single console.

sections.title: General capabilities
items: User sign-up, sign-in, sign-out and JWT refresh.
Current profile retrieval and user language update.
Available languages: French, Dutch, English, Italian and Spanish.
Secure JWT-based session handling on the frontend.

sections.title: Application capabilities
items: List, create, inspect, update and delete applications.
Activate, deactivate, revoke and regenerate the application token.
Expose the data needed for mobile or API integration.
Cover the full push application lifecycle.

sections.title: Device capabilities
items: List, inspect, update and delete visible devices.
Show which applications a device is linked to.
Automatically subscribe a device with its application token (X-App-Token).
Support the mobile flow: install, QR scan, retrieve push token and create or update the backend link.

sections.title: Notification capabilities
items: Create targeted notifications by application and explicit device list.
List, inspect, send manually and monitor notification statistics.
Manage future notifications: list, inspect, update and delete.
Filter by application, status and send date, taking partial sends and quiet-period postponements into account.

sections.title: Quiet period capabilities
items: Manage quiet periods at application or device level.
One-off or recurring periods, with update, delete and activation.
Handle windows crossing midnight and contiguous windows.
Reflect the distinct business impact: global notification shift for applications, device-only delivery delay for devices.

sections.title: Email delivery capability
items: Receive inbound email and resolve the target application from the recipient prefix.
Turn the subject into a notification title and the text body into a message, with optional `SEND_AT` scheduling.
Validate domain, sender and target application ownership.
Handle idempotency through `message_id`, rejecting replays with different content.

about.title: About PushIT.
about.description: PushIT is a simple console to manage your push notifications.

sections.title: The product
sections.body: PushIT centralizes the management of your applications, devices and push campaigns in a clear, modern console.

sections.title: The publisher
sections.body: PushIT is designed and maintained by Foxugly, which builds a small family of polished web tools.

sections.title: Technology
sections.body: A Django REST backend, an Angular frontend and notifications delivered through Firebase Cloud Messaging.

accountDeletion.title: Delete your PushIT account
accountDeletion.lead: PushIT is published by Foxugly SRL. You can delete your account and its data yourself, at any time, from the web console.
steps: Sign in to the console at https://pushit.foxugly.com, with the same account as in the mobile app.
In the “Danger zone” section, enter your current password and click “Delete my account”.
accountDeletion.forgotPassword: Forgot your password? Reset it first from the sign-in page.
deleted: Your account: email address, password and preferences.
Your devices and their notification tokens (Firebase Cloud Messaging).
The applications you own, for all their subscribers, with their notifications, delivery history, templates, send tokens and device links.
All your sessions, on every device.
retention: Data is erased from the production database immediately. Nothing is kept once the account is deleted.
Copies may remain in the platform’s encrypted backups, which are erased on rotation, at most about 8 weeks later.
accountDeletion.noAccess: Write to rvilain@foxugly.com from your account’s email address: we delete the account and its data within 30 days.
